title: Big Banks Quietly Charge $468/Year — For Nothing
hook: Your bank is taking $468 from you every year for fees most people never notice — and a free alternative has existed for years.
angle: Makes the hidden cost of big bank inertia concrete and personal, then presents the free switch as the obvious move any viewer can do today
audience: Anyone with a checking or savings account at Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, or Citi — 150+ million Americans
key_numbers: $468 — average annual fees at the top 4 US banks (maintenance, overdraft, ATM)
0.01% — interest rate big banks pay on savings accounts
4.75% — what top online banks pay on high-yield savings
$0 — monthly fees at Ally, Marcus, SoFi, and similar online banks
$2,800 — 5-year savings from switching (fees saved + interest earned)
